# Flamin.go: Full Extended Machine Specification (llms-full.txt)

This document contains the complete technical specification, REST API schemas, FastMCP tool definitions, and system prompts for Flamin.go.

---

## 1. System Overview & Authentication

Flamin.go exposes headless capabilities via two primary transport layers:
1. FastMCP (Model Context Protocol) over stdio or Server-Sent Events (SSE).
2. REST HTTP API under `https://api.flamin.go/v1`.

### Authentication
All HTTP requests require a standard Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```http
Authorization: Bearer flm_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

---

## 2. FastMCP Tool Definitions & Schemas

### Tool: `track_competitor_diff`
Monitors target URLs, extracts DOM diffs, analyzes positioning shifts, and generates executive teardowns.

**Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "target_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uri",
      "description": "Full URL of competitor landing page or pricing table."
    },
    "comparison_baseline_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Previous snapshot ID to compare against. If omitted, captures new baseline."
    },
    "extract_pricing": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Extract structured pricing tiers and interaction caps."
    }
  },
  "required": ["target_url"]
}
```

**Output Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["success", "unchanged", "error"] },
    "snapshot_id": { "type": "string" },
    "positioning_changes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "field": { "type": "string" },
          "previous": { "type": "string" },
          "current": { "type": "string" },
          "impact_score": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1 }
        }
      }
    },
    "pricing_diff": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

---

### Tool: `clean_document_to_markdown`
Firecrawl-style document sanitization that converts messy HTML, PDF, or Word documents into clean, LLM-ready markdown.

**Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source_content": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Raw HTML string or base64 encoded document bytes."
    },
    "content_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["html", "pdf", "docx"],
      "default": "html"
    },
    "strip_navigation": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true
    },
    "preserve_tables": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true
    }
  },
  "required": ["source_content"]
}
```

**Output Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "markdown": { "type": "string" },
    "token_count_estimate": { "type": "integer" },
    "extracted_links": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    }
  }
}
```

---

### Tool: `record_decision_node`
Semantica pattern: appends a deterministic decision node to the causal provenance DAG.

**Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "node_id": { "type": "string" },
    "parent_node_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "trigger_event": { "type": "string" },
    "reasoning": { "type": "string" },
    "action_taken": { "type": "string" },
    "confidence_score": { "type": "number" },
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  },
  "required": ["node_id", "trigger_event", "reasoning", "action_taken"]
}
```

---

### Tool: `verify_persona_isolation`
MatrAIx pattern: validates outbound payloads against cross-brand contamination and identity leakage.

**Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "brand_context": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["FLAMINGO", "ZERO_HYPE", "RENAISSANCE_GYM", "AI_BABIES", "TAAM", "APONIA", "ANONYMOUS_PERSONA"]
    },
    "outbound_payload": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["brand_context", "outbound_payload"]
}
```

**Output Schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "is_valid": { "type": "boolean" },
    "violations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "rule": { "type": "string" },
          "matched_pattern": { "type": "string" },
          "severity": { "type": "string", "enum": ["FATAL", "WARNING"] }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 3. HTTP REST Endpoints

### `POST /api/v1/agent/invoke`
Synchronous or asynchronous tool invocation gateway.
- **Request Body:** `{ "tool_name": "track_competitor_diff", "arguments": { ... } }`
- **Response 200:** `{ "success": true, "data": { ... }, "interaction_quota_remaining": 24890 }`
- **Response 429:** `{ "error": "interaction_cap_exceeded", "limit": 25000, "upgrade_url": "https://flamin.go/pricing" }`

### `GET /api/v1/graph/trace?node_id={node_id}`
Returns complete causal chain of reasoning for any historical agent decision.

---

## 4. Error Code Reference

| Code | HTTP Status | Meaning | Resolution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN` | 401 | Missing or invalid API bearer token | Verify token in operator cockpit |
| `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | 429 | Monthly agent interaction cap reached | Upgrade subscription tier |
| `ISOLATION_VIOLATION` | 403 | PersonaGuard intercepted leaked entity metadata | Sanitize outbound payload |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BURST` | 429 | Exceeded burst limit of 50 calls/sec | Apply exponential backoff |
| `PARSER_MALFORMED_DOM` | 422 | Target document could not be sanitized | Check source format |

---

## FAQ - Flamin.go

> Canonical: https://flamin-go.pages.dev/faq/ | Last updated: 2026-10-14

### 1. What is a Flamin teardown?
An async roast of your first 5 seconds: hero, headline, CTA, proof. Friction points plus exact rewrites, in 24-48h. No call.

### 2. How fast do I get it?
24-48h async. You send the URL; you get a written teardown document. No kickoff, no debrief call.

### 3. What do you actually rewrite?
Headlines first, then subhead, CTA microcopy, proof order. You get before/after blocks pasted straight into the page, so your team ships without guessing. See the 49 USD Studio Pack.

### 4. Who is this for?
Solo founders and micro-SaaS teams of 1-5 people. Indie and bootstrapped. Allergic to enterprise process. If your launch needs a steering committee, this is not for you.

### 5. Do you touch design or only copy?
Copy drives it; design notes only where layout kills conversion (contrast, hierarchy, one primary CTA). No full redesign.

### 6. How is this different from a generic audit?
First-5-seconds lens, CTA friction scoring, paste-ready rewrites. Not a 40-page PDF with stock advice.

### 7. What do you need from me?
URL, one-line ICP, current CTA and price. Enough to start.

### 8. Do you guarantee conversion lift?
No. Teardowns raise clarity and click probability; traffic quality still matters. Shippable fixes guaranteed, not percentages.

### 9. What does the 49 USD Studio Pack include?
Written teardown plus rewrite blocks plus machine endpoints (llms.txt, ai-info.html). One-time, async, no subscription.

### 10. How do we start?
Pick the Studio Pack CTA, send URL plus ICP. Teardown lands in 24-48h. Iterate async after.
